messages:
miguel: Hey team — running into weird scores from the rerank endpoint when we pass our stored embeddings + new query embeddings. Not getting an error, but top results are nonsense (all ~0.0001 scores). We think we might be mixing embedding models. Repro below.

sophie: Thanks for filing, miguel. Can you paste the exact payload you send to /v1/rerank and which model you used to create the doc embeddings vs the query embedding? Also which SDK / curl call?

miguel: Docs were embedded with model `open-embed-v2` (we started storing these in Jan). Query embedding we just generated with `text-embed-lite` from a client test flow. Payload:
```json
{
  "model": "rerank-default",
  "candidate_embeddings": [[...1536 floats...], [...1536...], ...],
  "query_embedding": [...2048 floats...],
  "top_k": 10
}
```
No 400, it returns a list with very low scores.

alex: That payload is the issue — candidate dims must match query dims. If you pass a 1536-dim candidate vector list with a 2048-dim query vector, the server currently falls back to a dot-product routine that truncates/pads silently in some codepaths which yields near-zero scores for mismatched vectors. We should fail-fast instead.

kai: I reproduced locally with the exact models: `open-embed-v2` -> 2048 dims, `text-embed-lite` -> 1536 dims (our internal names vary). When I mix them the rerank response contains unexpected low scores, no error. I grabbed a trace:
```
INFO rerank: received candidates: count=25 dim=1536
INFO rerank: query dim=2048
WARN rerank: candidate/query dim mismatch -> applying fallback kernel (silent padding)
RESULT scores: [0.00012, 0.00008, 0.00007, ...]
```

sophie: Yikes. Customer impact: silent mismatch -> bad relevance. miguel, sorry for the confusion. Two asks: 1) short-term: can you re-embed queries with the same model as your documents? 2) we'll push a server-side validation to return 400 if dims mismatch and include a clear message with model hints.

miguel: Re-embedding client-side is doable but expensive for us. Is there a cheap server-side conversion or shim we can use?

alex: No safe general conversion between different embedding spaces. You could re-index by re-embedding docs or keep a mapping table if you plan to switch models. For immediate safety we should: return a clear 400 + error 'embedding_dim_mismatch' with payload: `{expected:1536, got:2048, hint: 're-embed query or use matching model for candidates'}`.

kai: Plan: (1) Support will ask customers to re-embed (short-term), (2) Prod hotfix to validate dims and return 400 with guidance (PR ready), (3) Postmortem: improve docs and console tooling to surface model/dim when you upload embeddings and when you call rerank.

ops-bot: Deployment: canary rolling hotfix to rerank service queued (#ticket-9876).

sophie: Miguel — we'll create a scoped migration guide for you with re-embedding cost estimate and sample scripts. Can you share approximate doc count and embedding storage location (S3 prefix)?

miguel: ~200k docs, stored in s3://acme-embeds/v1/. Thanks, please keep me posted.

alex: Quick repro snippet we used:
```bash
# generate query embedding (text-embed-lite, 1536)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"text-embed-lite","input":"foo"}'
# use stored docs from open-embed-v2 (2048) and call rerank
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -d '{"model":"rerank-default","query_embedding": [...2048...],"candidate_embeddings":[...1536...]}'
```
This reproduces silent fallback -> bad scores.

kai: I'll attach logs + PR link in the ticket and schedule the hotfix. Thanks all.

sophie: Closing loop: created support ticket #9876, assigned to eng/runtime, ETA for hotfix: 3h, customer notified. :thumbsup:
